Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Manoj - 36 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Hema - 60 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The forest - tall trees, thick bushes
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Manoj stands by the road. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "Let's do something fun today."

[Manoj rides his motorbike to the market.]

Manoj: "That was fun!"

[Manoj starts his scooter and rides off.]

Hema (softly): "That's great!"

[Manoj drives the car to the office.]

Hema (softly): "Okay, Manoj."

[Manoj gets out of the car.]

Manoj (surprised): "Let's see."

[Manoj rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Hema (laughing): "What next?"

[Manoj takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Hema: "Manoj, are you okay?"

Scene 2: The forest - Day

Hema: "What a nice place."

[Manoj goes hunting and aims his bow at a deer.]

Hema (happily): "Good job, Manoj!"

[Manoj rides an elephant through the forest.]

Manoj: "This is amazing!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Manoj stands in the living room. Hema stands near him.]

Manoj: "What a nice place."

[Manoj staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Manoj: "Let's see."

[Manoj and Mother clink their glasses.]

Manoj: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
